reason: At ₹12,990 a year, it is a steep commitment for a frugal firm when we can just test the free sandbox with one trainee on 5 clients first before paying anything.
objection: I want to prevent trainees from keeping client data on their personal laptops, but why pay ₹12,990 upfront when I can test the free tier first to see if the Trainee Laptop Shield actually works?
would_change_my_mind: Pricing under ₹8,000 a year combined with endpoint download restrictions to stop article clerks from saving client files on personal laptops.
